Other 2026 MOFCOM notices listed on the same pages on 26 November 2026 (for example Nos. 1, 26, 29, 34, 48 to 53 and the entity-list notices): none modifies Announcement No. 46 of 2024 or the six October 2025 announcements, and none is coded here.
The undated first entries the published record keeps for the clauses of Announcement No. 61 of 2025. They are unchanged.

The remainder of Announcement No. 51, including other list items and other instruments in Annex 2, requires a separate historical crosswalk. The selective graphite tag on the candidate event describes the coverage of this pilot.
